content.comment_body: I am sharing an existing program featuring two timers. I want to use a function key on the [product_name] display to change the timer parameter, for example from one hour to 30 seconds. Any guidance would be welcome. Thanks in advance.

Hello, Changing a timer parameter directly in message text is only allowed within the same time range as the timer's current setting. In your case, you should set the unit to "minutes." This will let you adjust from 60 minutes down to 0.3 minutes. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a simple solution to alter a timer parameter on the [product_name] display by pressing a function key. There is a limitation where only parameters within the same time range can be changed in message text. Using 'minutes' as the unit is recommended for greater adjustment flexibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily and flexibly modify timer parameters from the [product_name] display with a function key, without being restricted by timer units or time ranges.
